test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The dog was run over by a truck.

options.text: A truck had run over the dog.
A truck runs over the dog.
A truck has run over the dog.
A truck ran over the dog.

solution:
The correct answer is '**A truck ran over the dog.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in P
